baseline: DIRECT_MARKET: race-normalized inverse purchasable pre-race win odds at the preregistered snapshot

residual_learner.objective: mean over races of winner negative log likelihood under market-offset conditional softmax + 0.5*lambda_l2*||beta||^2
residual_learner.race_weighting: EQUAL_PER_RACE; never weight a race by horse count
residual_learner.linear_predictor: beta dot standardized six-feature vector; NO INTERCEPT
residual_learner.zero_prior_start: raw residual fixed to 0; excluded from coefficient-gradient rows but retained in the race softmax denominator/evaluation population
residual_learner.market_offset: log DIRECT_MARKET probability is fixed offset, never a fitted coefficient
residual_learner.initial_beta: all zeros so initial candidate equals DIRECT_MARKET exactly

preprocessing.fit_population: TRAIN split history-eligible rows only (horse_prior_starts>0 and all required history fields present)
preprocessing.scale: training-only population standard deviation per feature (ddof=0)
preprocessing.eval_transform: reuse frozen training mean/std; never refit on DEV-eval/VALIDATION/OOS
preprocessing.zero_prior_rows: do not impute standardized history values because their residual is fixed 0

optimizer.convergence_failure: FAIL_CLOSED; no alternate optimizer chosen after observing outcomes

required_invariants: beta=0 implies candidate probabilities exactly equal DIRECT_MARKET
uniform market implies normalized_entropy=1, alpha_eff=0, and candidate equals market regardless of beta
all probabilities positive and sum to one per race
analytic gradient agrees with finite differences before any real trial
each race contributes equal primary-loss weight
zero-prior horses stay in denominator and have residual exactly 0
no current market field enters the residual feature vector
blocked_until: Race-time Snapshot Gate v5 real Windows/JV-Link forward provenance PASS
all source hashes and train/eval periods fixed
